title: The ramp's rail, worn
logline: The ramp's rail, close, worn pale where a hand goes, and the hand on it: Gully's, heavy, from above. Ten years of the same hand in the same place. The page draws the pale as the years.

panels.composition: Close on a plank ramp's wooden rail worn pale in one place with a heavy man's hand resting there from above, the dock's planks below.
